data.name: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
data.detailed_description:
Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece Nearly 4 times longer than the first game this nightmare will send goosebumps down your spine!

Puzzles

  • Decode hidden codes buried in environmental patterns

  • Solve multi-layered magnetic puzzles where timing and polarity matter

  • Manipulate distant objects using the Magnet Watch to open paths

  • Stack, suspend, and launch metal blocks to create improvised solutions

  • Use physics in unstable ways: bridge gaps, and weaponize the environment itself

  • Use the brand new electro-magnet to control electric currents

  • use electric powers against your enemy's 

 The Mechanics

  • Pull distant metal objects toward you with controlled force

  • shoot electric currents

  • bend electric circuit's to open doors

  • use different tools to light your path

  • Launch debris and metal boxes as improvised projectiles

  • use lighter objects to pull yourself up higher

  • Break glass barriers by accelerating metal at dangerous velocity

  • Chain interactions together for emergent movement puzzles

Horror

  • Persistent stealth where sound is a liability and silence is survival

  • Chase sequences through collapsing buildings

  • Body horror elements tied to experiments and mild blood/gore

  • Creeping ambient audio, distortions, and distant footsteps that play when nothing should be active

Something is always moving just outside your line of sight.

 Story

  • Discover files of experiments that began normal and end in death

  • Piece together why the facility feels so alive

  • Learn what happens when people have to much power.

This story is still in full of mystery and will leave you hooked on what really happened

 Features

  • Physics-driven puzzle horror gameplay

  • Magnet-based traversal

  • electricity manipulation 

  • Stealth encounters with unpredictable threat

  • Atmospheric exploration of a decaying Mental facility

  • Psychological horror layered with industrial body horror

  • A narrative that will keep you gripped

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Recommended disk space of 10gb for best experience
